mapper.select: select pr.payroll_id, e.employee_no, e.name as employee_name, e.account_number, e.bank_name, d.department_name, p.position_name, max(case when pd.item_name_snapshot = '기본급' then pd.amount else 0 end) as basic_salary_amount, max(case when pd.item_name_snapshot = '식대' then pd.amount else 0 end) as meal_allowance_amount, max(case when pd.item_name_snapshot = '교통비' then pd.amount else 0 end) as transportation_allowance_amount, max(case when pd.item_name_snapshot = '직책수당' then pd.amount else 0 end) as responsibility_allowance_amount from payroll pr left join payroll_detail pd on pd.payroll_id = pr.payroll_id left join employee e on pr.employee_id = e.employee_id left join department d on d.department_id = e.department_id left join positions p on e.position_id = p.position_id
select * from payroll_detail where item_name_snapshot = '기본급' and payroll_id = #{payrollId}

select avg(pd.amount) as average_basic_salary, max(pd.amount) as max_basic_salary, sum(pd.amount)as total_basic_salary_amount, e.name as max_basic_salary_employee_name, pos.position_name as max_basic_salary_employee_position_name from payroll p left join payroll_detail pd on pd.payroll_id = p.payroll_id left join employee e on e.employee_id = p.employee_id left join positions pos on e.position_id = pos.position_id where p.payroll_year_month = #{payrollYearMonth} and pd.item_name_snapshot = '기본급'

select sum(pd.amount)as total_allowance_amount from payroll p left join payroll_detail pd on pd.payroll_id = p.payroll_id left join employee e on e.employee_id = p.employee_id where p.payroll_year_month = #{payrollYearMonth} and pd.item_name_snapshot not in ('기본급')

select COALESCE(avg(case when p.payroll_year_month = #{payrollYearMonth} then pd.amount else 0 end)) - COALESCE(avg(case when p.payroll_year_month = #{payrollLastYearMonth} then pd.amount else 0 end)) as compareLastMonthAmount from payroll p left join payroll_detail pd on p.payroll_id = pd.payroll_id where p.payroll_year_month in (#{payrollYearMonth}, #{payrollLastYearMonth}) and pd.item_name_snapshot = '기본급'
